objective: Elevate the Story Dossier from a writer aid into the versioned Canonical Intelligence Engine that controls downstream article production.

implementedCapabilities.result: Each locked dossier can now produce a versioned canonical intelligence object with event identity, evidence, timeline, entities, context, intelligence, publication planning, writer contract, and consumer contract.
Locked dossiers now expose a stable dossierRevisionId so Writer, Headline, Image, Editor, Repair, Newsletter, Creator Desk, and future lanes can reference the same event understanding.
Writer Reasoning now consumes the canonical dossier revision and blocks standard/deep writing when the writer contract is not ready.
Image Intelligence now draws actor/action/consequence/category/entity context from the canonical dossier when available instead of rebuilding visual context from loose article fields.
Published payload compaction now preserves a compact canonical dossier reference and dossierRevisionId without exposing the full internal object through the viewer API.

preventionRule.problem: Downstream systems drift when Writer, Headline, Image, Editor, Repair, Newsletter, and Creator Desk each reconstruct story context independently.
preventionRule.fix: Route every downstream system through the same locked canonical dossier revision.
preventionRule.avoidance: Before drafting, editing, repairing, selecting an image, or producing derivative content, verify a canonical dossier revision exists and the relevant consumer records that revision.
preventionRule.learningSignal: A future story identity mismatch should be treated as a failure to consume or honor the canonical dossier revision, not as an isolated headline or writer error.

verification.publicApiSafety: Viewer API continues to use slim public story objects and does not return the full canonical intelligence contract.
verification.nextRuntimeCheck: Confirm new stories include dossierRevisionId and imageDossier.canonicalIntelligenceRef.consumed=true after the next worker publication cycle.
